name: Cisco ASA — VPN Authentication Brute Force From Single IP
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "109006"
| comp count() as fails,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       count_distinct(xdm.source.user.username) as targeted_users
       by xdm.source.ipv4
| filter fails >= 3
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users
description: ≥3 ASA 109006 authentication-failed events grouped by source IP within 30 minutes — VPN credential brute force / password spray.
alert_name: Cisco ASA — VPN Authentication Brute Force From Single IP
